updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
Release 3.0.9.2
- Add support for AH/MH-6j Little Bird community mod
- Adds new Single PTT mode functionality for AH-64D Apache
- Adds new Single PTT mode functionality for CH-47F Chinook
- Adds new Single PTT mode functionality for C-130J Hercules
- Adds a new Chatter Theme ‘Andersen’
- Adds new Chatter theme independent randomization timing
- Adds new Dark Mode support for Vaicom UI
- Fixes Jester Nav Grid commands not working
- Fixes Jester NAV GRID Enable/Disable toggle
- Fixes JF-17 not being detected
- Fixes F10 menu scanning not running after initial mission scan
- Fixes F10 menu items not being reset and removes blank spaces
- Fixes Kola terrain radio.lua updating no longer required
